title: Rook endings: the Lucena position
summary: The winning method with rook and pawn: build a bridge.
body:
**Lucena:** your pawn is on the 7th, your king in front of it, the enemy king cut off by your rook. You win by **building a bridge**:

1. Check the enemy king one more file away.
2. Bring your rook to the **4th rank** (the bridge).
3. Walk your king out; when the checks come, block them with the rook on the 4th.

Learn this one by heart - it is the most important winning position in chess.

examples.prompt: White to move and win. First push the black king further away.
examples.explain: Rd1+ drives the king to the e-file, then Rd4! builds the bridge. Your king will walk out to c7 and block the checks with Rb4/Rc4.

examples.prompt: White to move. The bridge is ready - get the king out.
examples.explain: Kc7! and walk toward the rook. When checks run out, the rook on the 4th rank blocks and the pawn queens.
